result.summary: Found 2 issues: a truncated restaurant name in the fastest carousel and a nonsensical -0% discount badge on a popular item.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in Fastest near you is cut off mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of the full name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles fully display (wrap to two lines, shrink text, or widen cards) so names are not truncated.

issues.description: The lower popular card shows a '-0%' badge, which is meaningless as a discount label.
issues.suggestion: Hide percentage badges when the value is 0, or show a clearer promo label only when there is a real offer.
